jei.jaymoskitchen.juicing.tub: Pour the grapes into the tub, then jump in it: each landing treads them.
jei.jaymoskitchen.juicing.press: Fill the press with apples and turn the screw with an empty hand.
jei.jaymoskitchen.winemaking.juice: Pour three bottles of juice into a cask.
jei.jaymoskitchen.winemaking.grapes: Fill a cask with the grapes and water.
jei.jaymoskitchen.winemaking.cellar: Wine waiting in a cool cellar improves for up to five in-game years; older wine sells for more.
jei.jaymoskitchen.drying.sun: Needs the sun on the rack.
jei.jaymoskitchen.vine: Prune a vine with shears in winter and it bears the most; one left alone bears less each year. Hang a net (string) over it to keep the birds off the ripe bunches. Use an empty hand to pick.
jei.jaymoskitchen.nether_vine: Grows only near lava. Shear it to prune it at any time.
jei.jaymoskitchen.tea_bush: Likes shade and rain. Pick the leaves when it is in leaf, dry them on a rack in the sun.
jei.jaymoskitchen.tea_kettle: Brews in the tea kettle like any tea herb.
jei.jaymoskitchen.tea_pot: Pour cups of tea into it: it serves everyone sitting on a cushion nearby.
jei.jaymoskitchen.wood_chip: Carry one when a smoker finishes meat well: it keeps %s times as long as raw and fills %s more.
